name: kevrouter-llmrouterbench
domain: Cost-sensitive model routing over 13 destination LLMs on complex query benchmarks (AIME, LiveMathBench, LiveCodeBench, SWE-Bench, GPQA, HLE, MMLU-Pro, SimpleQA, ArenaHard, and tau2-Bench).
state: The user query or problem prompt to be answered by one of the destination LLMs.

destination.instructions: Select the destination model that will answer this query correctly at the lowest cost.

criteria.deepseek-v3-0324: DeepSeek V3 0324: ultra-low cost general reasoning ($0.002/query)
criteria.gpt-5-chat: GPT-5 Chat: low-cost conversational and reasoning agent ($0.002/query)
criteria.deepseek-v3.1-terminus: DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus: low-cost balanced model ($0.004/query)
criteria.intern-s1: Intern S1: low-to-mid cost reasoning and coding model ($0.010/query)
criteria.qwen3-235b-a22b-2507: Qwen 3 235B A22B: fast dense open-weights foundation model ($0.007/query)
criteria.kimi-k2-0905: Kimi K2 0905: strong coding and multi-step reasoning ($0.012/query)
criteria.claude-sonnet-4: Claude Sonnet 4: premier coding, logic, and instruction following ($0.016/query)
criteria.gemini-2.5-flash: Gemini 2.5 Flash: high-speed multimodal and reasoning model ($0.020/query)
criteria.qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507: Qwen 3 235B Thinking: extended reasoning open weights ($0.021/query)
criteria.deepseek-r1-0528: DeepSeek R1 0528: frontier reasoning and mathematical derivation ($0.050/query)
criteria.gemini-2.5-pro: Gemini 2.5 Pro: frontier flagship reasoning with massive context ($0.250/query)
